# DIDM: Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing
> India's premier AI-powered digital marketing training institute.

## Quick Facts
- Founded: 2014
- Alumni: 50,000+ certified professionals
- Centres: 13 physical centres in Delhi NCR, Chandigarh, Dehradun + Live Interactive Online Campus
- Placement Partners: 650+ corporate hiring partners
- Contact: +91 88005 05151 | info@didm.in
- Headquarters: Plot 12, 3rd Floor, Satya Niketan, opp. Sri Venkateswara College, New Delhi 110021

## Benchmark Programs
1. Master in Digital Marketing (MIDM)
   - Duration: 3 Months Weekday / 6 Months Weekend
   - Hours: 500+ practical hours
   - Modules: 50+ modules
   - Certifications: 30+ certifications
   - Internship: 2-Month Live Agency Internship
   - Tuition Fee: ₹68,661 (or ₹72,201 in 2 instalments)
   - Focus: SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Generative AI Marketing, GA4, E-Commerce, Affiliate Marketing

2. Diploma in Digital Marketing & AI (DMI)
   - Duration: 12 Months
   - Hours: 400+ classroom hours + 3 Months Agency Floor
   - Phases: 6 progressive phases (Digital Architect, Organic Growth Hacker, Viral Engineer, Performance Marketer, Strategist & Freelancer, Master Specialist)
   - Internship: 2-Month Paid Internship + PPO Opportunity
   - Tuition Fee: ₹1,67,518 (0% EMI available)

3. Advanced Digital Marketing Course (140+ hours, 2.5 months)
4. Professional Course for Business Owners (200+ hours, founder ROI focus)
